title: Document
summary: Render the SSR document and reconcile its client-side language and theme classes.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: Accepts DocumentProps: HTML attributes and children, plus an optional boolean data-debug attribute. Pass an explicit lang value for accessible server markup.

sections.title: Returns
sections.body: On the server, renders an html element with the supplied attributes and children. In the browser, returns the children without creating another html element.

sections.title: Root layout
sections.body: Use Document in the root module's Layout component. Keep metadata, links, and hydration scripts in that layout so the server and browser render the same document structure.

sections.title: Hydration and subsequent changes
sections.body: Hydration preserves classes that a theme bootstrap already added to document.documentElement. When className changes later, Document removes classes from the previous prop and adds the new ones, leaving unrelated classes intact. It also updates lang and data-debug. Other HTML attributes are forwarded during server rendering but are not synchronized by the browser effect.

sections.title: Externally injected head elements
sections.body: Whole-document hydration expects the server and client layouts to match. Mark externally injected direct children of head with data-smolter-preserve. mountApplication temporarily excludes those nodes from hydration and restores the same nodes afterward; the application must not also render them. This is an explicit integration contract, not automatic tolerance of arbitrary HTML rewriting. Do not use it for application-owned tags, body content, or changes to the hydration payload.
